rootCause: QA once-bound click listener on the originally found TR is lost when a store hydration/render replaces the TR before the Playwright click; browser renders detail but captured clickAt remains null.
remediation: Keep document-level capture listener until it receives a click on the exact matching #host policy row, ignoring other clicks; no once on document, no binding to transient row. Preserve wall/browser metric and strict <2500ms assertion.
